aetherium.button.open_shader_screen: Abrir tela de pacotes de shader
aetherium.button.write_conflict_report: Gravar relatório de conflitos no log
aetherium.option.advanced.conflict_auto_: Hand features back to a conflicting mod instead of double-applying them.
Enable dev-level logging (hot-path cost: near zero when off).
aetherium.option.advanced.experimental_f: NOT SHIPPED. Setting this true is refused at startup: an error is logged and the engine runs in shadow (Compatibility) mode. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, "Honest status".
Crash with a report instead of falling back to Compatibility mode.
aetherium.option.advanced.gl_errors.tool: Check glGetError at pass boundaries in debug builds.
require=1 on every injection, so a version delta that no longer matches fails the launch instead of silently skipping.
aetherium.option.android.battery_saver.t: Cap FPS, halve upload budget, stop background meshing on battery.
aetherium.option.android.enabled.tooltip: Enable launcher/renderer probing. No-op on desktop.
Override the detected renderer; use when the launcher env is unreadable.
aetherium.option.android.memory_budget_m: Soft ceiling for native arenas; auto-detected from cgroup limits when 0.
aetherium.option.android.mobile_memory.t: Shrink arenas, mesh cache and texture mips to the heap budget.
aetherium.option.android.read_custom_env: Parse the launcher's custom_env.txt for renderer hints.
aetherium.option.android.thermal_ceiling: Package temperature at which Aetherium starts shedding work.
aetherium.option.android.thermal_throttl: Read thermal zones and back off before the SoC clocks down.
aetherium.option.android.touch_mode.tool: 48dp hit targets, swipe scroll, long-press tooltips.
aetherium.option.general.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. false = Compatibility mode (vanilla renderer), live, no restart.
aetherium.option.general.hud.backend_tag: Append [Aetherium/GL46] to the F3 header line.
aetherium.option.general.hud.corner.tool: Overlay anchor: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.
aetherium.option.general.hud.frame_graph: Spike graph of the last 240 frames.
aetherium.option.general.notify_conflict: Show a notice on screen (top-right, under the backend tag) when a conflicting renderer mod is present.
aetherium.option.performance.async_meshi: Mesh sections off-thread with distance priority.
aetherium.option.performance.backend.too: Backend selection. AUTO probes the GPU and picks the best available.
Pyramid depth; larger = cheaper tests, coarser rejection.
aetherium.option.performance.indirect_ba: Draw-command slots allocated up front; the GPU-visible count decides how many are used.
aetherium.option.performance.mesh_worker: 0 = auto (min(availableProcessors()-1, 8)). Applies on next world load.
aetherium.option.performance.persistent_: Persistent mapped buffers with triple buffering + fences.
aetherium.option.performance.program_cac: Disk-cache GL program binaries (skips recompiles across launches).
0 = uncapped. Soft cap applied after the swap; never blocks the render thread.
aetherium.option.performance.upload_budg: Per-frame ceiling on mapped-buffer uploads; keeps upload spikes out of the frame graph.
Frustum + occlusion culling of entity render dispatches.
aetherium.option.quality.max_direct_ligh: Maximum direct block light written to the lightmap.
aetherium.option.quality.weather.tooltip: Rain/snow quality; FAST also silences weather particle churn.
aetherium.option.shaders.iris_integratio: Bind the Iris/Oculus v0 API by reflection when present.
aetherium.option.shaders.pause_dynamic_l: Disable dynamic lightmap writes while a shader pack owns the lightmap.
aetherium.option.shaders.reload_on_world: Re-apply pack options on dimension/world change.
aetherium.option.utilities.dynamic_light: Use per-source RGB instead of a white falloff.
Item/entity light sources written into the lightmap.
Light from entities holding a light source.
0 off, 1 sources only, 2 + attenuation smoothing, 3 + occlusion test.
Full-brightness slider; 20.0 is the cave-vision ceiling.
aetherium.option.utilities.gamma.cave_vi: Raise the block-light floor only while the camera is under skylight 0.
Effective block light guaranteed by cave vision.
aetherium.option.utilities.gamma.curve.t: Monotone control points 'x:y,...' — see gamma.GammaCurve; blank disables the curve editor.
aetherium.option.utilities.gamma.enabled: Override the vanilla lightmap gamma response.
aetherium.option.utilities.gamma.night_v: Brighten the sky-light channel at night without changing block light.
Sky-light floor applied by night vision boost.
aetherium.option.utilities.gamma.time_ba: Blend gamma between a day and a night target using world time.
Gamma applied at midnight when time-based gamma is on.
